observed_rich={}
def rich_records(stream,start):
    for kind,payload,offset in original_records(stream,start):
        if kind==0xfc:
            total,unique=struct.unpack_from('<II',payload)
            cursor=8
            plain=bytearray(payload[:8])
            for index in range(unique):
                length,flags=struct.unpack_from('<HB',payload,cursor)
                cursor+=3
                assert flags & ~0x0d == 0
                runs=struct.unpack_from('<H',payload,cursor)[0] if flags & 8 else 0
                cursor+=2 if flags & 8 else 0
                ext=struct.unpack_from('<I',payload,cursor)[0] if flags & 4 else 0
                cursor+=4 if flags & 4 else 0
                end=cursor+length*(2 if flags & 1 else 1)
                assert end+4*runs+ext <= len(payload), 'Same-record oracle cannot decode continuation'
                raw=payload[cursor:end]
                plain.extend(struct.pack('<HB',length,flags & 1))
                plain.extend(raw)
                if flags & 8:
                    observed_rich[index]={'text':raw.decode('utf-16le' if flags & 1 else 'latin1'),
                                          'run_count':runs,'runs_raw_hex':payload[end:end+4*runs].hex()}
                cursor=end+4*runs+ext
            assert cursor==len(payload)
            payload=bytes(plain)
        yield kind,payload,offset
oracle.records=rich_records

from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,struct,subprocess,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,'tests')
from wps_source_oracle import workbook_stream,records,coordinate
root=Path.cwd(); task=Path('/private/tmp/et-edge-audit-20261112')
evidence_path=Path('docs/maintenance/et/edge-real-samples-20261112.json')
e=json.loads(evidence_path.read_text())
for item in e['samples']:
    name=item['filename']; data=(task/name).read_bytes(); r=json.loads((task/(name+'.json')).read_text())
    stream=workbook_stream(data)
    sheet_starts=[]
    for kind,p,offset in records(stream,0):
        if kind==0x85:
            length,flags=p[6:8]
            sheet_starts.append((p[8:8+length*(2 if flags & 1 else 1)].decode('utf-16le' if flags & 1 else 'latin1'),struct.unpack_from('<I',p)[0]))
        if kind==10: break
    blank_checks=0; merged_checks=0
    for sheet_name,start in sheet_starts:
        actual=next(s for s in r['sheets'] if s['name']==sheet_name)
        expected_positions=set(); merges=[]
        for kind,p,offset in records(stream,start):
            if kind==10: break
            if kind in (0x201,0xfd,0x203,6,0x27e,0x205):
                row,col=struct.unpack_from('<HH',p)
                address=coordinate(row,col); expected_positions.add(address)
                if kind==0x201:
                    assert actual['cells'][address]['type']=='blank'
                    blank_checks+=1
            elif kind in (0xbe,0xbd):
                row,first=struct.unpack_from('<HH',p); last=struct.unpack_from('<H',p,len(p)-2)[0]
                for col in range(first,last+1):
                    address=coordinate(row,col); expected_positions.add(address)
                    if kind==0xbe:
                        assert actual['cells'][address]['type']=='blank'
                        blank_checks+=1
            elif kind==0xe5:
                count=struct.unpack_from('<H',p)[0]
                assert len(p)==2+count*8
                for i in range(count):
                    a,b,c,d=struct.unpack_from('<HHHH',p,2+i*8)
                    merges.append(coordinate(a,c)+':'+coordinate(b,d))
        assert set(actual['cells'])==expected_positions,(name,sheet_name,'cell address set mismatch')
        assert [v['range'] for v in actual['merges']]==merges,(name,actual['merges'],merges)
        merged_checks+=len(merges)
    item['independent_blank_cells_checked']=blank_checks
    item['independent_merge_ranges_checked']=merged_checks
    item['all_cell_address_sets_match']=True
    args=['/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.14','-I','-S','-B',str(root/'skills/et/scripts/read_et.py'),'./'+name,'--summary']
    p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=task,capture_output=True,text=True); summary=json.loads(p.stdout)
    assert p.returncode==3 and summary['status']=='partial'
    item['summary_check']={'exit':p.returncode,'stderr':p.stderr,'json_valid':True,'schema_version':summary['schema_version'],'command':args}
    assert hashlib.sha256((task/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
with evidence_path.open('w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(e,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2); f.write('\n')
print('blank_cells',sum(s['independent_blank_cells_checked'] for s in e['samples']),'merge_ranges',sum(s['independent_merge_ranges_checked'] for s in e['samples']),'summary passed',len(e['samples']))
